literal: Harm - even to those who did - sweet things indeed - if not done - what - use is it - nobility?
translation: If one does not do good even to those who have done them harm, what is the use of nobility?
modern: தமக்குத் துன்பம் செய்தவர்க்கும் இனிய நன்மைகளைச் செய்யாவிட்டால், ஒருவருடைய சால்பினால் என்ன பயன்?
explanation: This couplet questions the very purpose of nobility or perfection of character (சால்பு). It states that the true test of such greatness is responding to harm (இன்னா) with kindness. If a noble person cannot do good even to those who have wronged them, their nobility yields no real fruit (என்ன பயத்ததோ). The emphasis marker in இனியவே stresses that only sweet or good deeds should be returned for evil.
